on_devil_s_glen.name: Devil's Glen
on_devil_s_glen.note: No source names months; access status dominates; summer buggy/hot only.

wy_grand_teton_national_park.name: Grand Teton National Park
wy_grand_teton_national_park.note: NPS mountaineering notes: best weather mid-July through August; guides: late July-Aug core, September good if dry.

az_5_windy_ridge.name: Windy Ridge
az_5_windy_ridge.note: Sources say winter/early spring good and avoid Jun-Aug heat, but name no climbing months.

nv_juniper_canyon.name: Juniper Canyon
nv_juniper_canyon.note: HELD by reviewer: shaded big-wall canyon (Rainbow Wall); Red Rocks-wide winter window not shown to apply. Red Rock sources: best October to early April, Nov-Mar prime; summer heat rules out June-Aug.

ab_bow_valley.name: Bow Valley
ab_bow_valley.note: MP: rock season April-October; Petzl guide: May-September best, September ideal; Oct hit or miss. Shared window May-Sep.

ca_santa_monica_mountains.name: Santa Monica Mountains
ca_santa_monica_mountains.note: Year-round with hot summers; rain-wet sandstone caution; no months named.

id_castle_rocks_2.name: Castle Rocks
id_castle_rocks_2.note: Best May-June and Sep-Oct (spring/fall); summer too hot; upper City not ready until mid-April.

qc_lac_long.name: Lac Long
qc_lac_long.note: FQME says spring to fall (SW-facing); no months named.

sd_sunshine.name: Sunshine
sd_sunshine.note: Fall best, Sunshine Wall a winter-sun crag, others say nearly year-round; contradictory, no months.

ca_lower_gorge.name: Lower Gorge
ca_lower_gorge.note: Sources say late fall-spring (Bishop Visitor) vs spring and fall (guidebook); no months named.

mt_northwest_region.name: Northwest Region
mt_northwest_region.note: Region too broad; forum says May-Oct rock near Missoula, other sources spring/fall only.

ar_west_side.name: West Side
ar_west_side.note: SummitPost says spring and fall ideal; no months named, MP chart unreadable.

bc_northern_bc.name: Northern BC
bc_northern_bc.note: No season source found for northern BC.

ca_d_camp_4_area.name: Camp 4 Area
ca_d_camp_4_area.note: Valley sources name April-May and September-October; summer hot.

ky_natural_bridge_region.name: Natural Bridge Region
ky_natural_bridge_region.note: Reviewer: Red River Gorge system window confirmed high in round 1. Red River Gorge as a whole: Oct-Nov driest/coolest; May, Jun, Sep, Oct best; Jul-Aug hot and humid. No Natural Bridge-specific source.

wa_beacon_rock.name: Beacon Rock
wa_beacon_rock.note: Season is set by raptor closures (S/SE faces Feb 1 to mid-July; NW face year-round); no climbing-months source.

nm_taos_area.name: Taos Area
nm_taos_area.note: taos.org and MP both say rock climbing season is year round; gorge best winter mornings, higher crags in midsummer.

mt_east_side.name: East Side
mt_east_side.note: One regional guide says April-October; shoulder seasons cold/wet; no agreeing second source.

qc_montagne_d_argent.name: Montagne d'Argent
qc_montagne_d_argent.note: Open year-round with ice in winter; no rock-season months found.

vt_boulders_behind_the_main_parking_lot_.name: Boulders Behind the Main Parking Lot/Visitor Center
vt_boulders_behind_the_main_parking_lot_.note: Summer/fall suggested, road closed Nov-May, but no month-naming climbing source.
